candidate_definition: LemLite._causal_plan_record's candidates at the saved planning event: the planner's chosen first order, hold (every handle where it is, the eyes at the last realised eye command), the controller's own proposal, and two perturbations of the chosen order at the babble's sizes from the production seed
execution: each candidate through the decision's own execution transform, smoother and hand path; held for the order's tenure (motor_hold moments) with the eyes at its gaze command; the saved world's reflex and saccades run as in production; every branch replayed and its physical trace required bit-identical

rules.forward_model_flat: flat unless BOTH the slope of Judge B's predicted-outcome difference on its actual-outcome difference AND the pooled captured share of the between-candidate token difference over Judge B's four senses (planner route, 50 ms) have 95% body intervals entirely above 0
rules.evaluator_flat: flat unless the slope of Judge B's actual-outcome difference on the grounded wellness difference (50 ms) has a 95% body interval entirely above 0
rules.planner_ignores_predicted_wellness: the planner's objective gives predicted wellness weight 0 (intention_gen._wellness_w) and the chosen order's mean rank by predicted wellness is not better than chance (the interval's upper end is not below (K + 1) / 2)
rules.depth_claim: looking further ahead causes a better physical decision only when the order selected by predicted wellness at 150 ms beats the order selected at 50 ms in actual grounded wellness averaged over the order's tenure, paired over the same starts, 95% body interval above 0

memory_budget_note: 12 GiB declared from the sibling probes' budget (the harness measured the v4 probe suite at 8.24 GB peak private commit); this run records its own peak
checkpoint_episode: episode companion restored (8 bodies saved; 8 caregiver recording tape(s) replaced by a plain list)

tie_band.definition: 90th percentile over candidate pairs of |predicted difference - grounded difference| one moment after the order, on the 0-to-5 sum

evaluator.definition: slope of Judge B's difference between two candidates' ACTUAL outcomes on their grounded wellness difference, one moment after (1 = sees the whole true difference, 0 = blind to it)

forward_model.definition: slope of Judge B's difference between two candidates' PREDICTED outcomes on its difference between their ACTUAL outcomes (1 = the forecast hands Judge B every difference reality does, 0 = none)

chain.definition: slope of the planner's predicted wellness difference on the grounded difference: the whole route the production tie is judged on

rules.forward_model_flat: flat unless BOTH the slope of Judge B's predicted-outcome difference on its actual-outcome difference AND the pooled captured share of the between-candidate token difference over Judge B's four senses (planner route, 50 ms) have 95% body intervals entirely above 0
rules.evaluator_flat: flat unless the slope of Judge B's actual-outcome difference on the grounded wellness difference (50 ms) has a 95% body interval entirely above 0
rules.planner_ignores_predicted_wellness: the planner's objective gives predicted wellness weight 0 (intention_gen._wellness_w) and the chosen order's mean rank by predicted wellness is not better than chance (the interval's upper end is not below (K + 1) / 2)
rules.depth_claim: looking further ahead causes a better physical decision only when the order selected by predicted wellness at 150 ms beats the order selected at 50 ms in actual grounded wellness averaged over the order's tenure, paired over the same starts, 95% body interval above 0

definitions.tie_band: the approximate evaluator's error on the difference between two candidates, 90th percentile; a predicted gap inside it counts as tied (0-to-5 wellness sum)
definitions.transfer: how much of one stage's difference between two candidates reaches the next stage (regression slope through zero over candidate pairs): 1 = all of it, 0 = none
definitions.captured_share: how much of the ACTUAL token difference between two candidates the PREDICTED difference foresaw along its direction: 1 = all of it, 0 = none, negative = the wrong way
definitions.turn_closed_share: of every body handle's ordered turn, the share the body closed over the order's tenure: 1 = arrived, 0 = no nearer, below 0 = further away
definitions.eye_error_deg: the eyes' mean azimuth/elevation distance from their command at the order's end, degrees; the decoder drives each eye joint to its signed command inside the joint limits, so this is the travel still left (servo speed, joint limits, reflex and saccade overrides); hold commands where the eyes already are
definitions.depth: 1 = 50 ms, 3 = 150 ms (the order held); the order's tenure is motor_hold moments
